projectSnapshot.title: RC capacitance sweep and frequency response
projectSnapshot.question: How does capacitance move a filter response at a chosen frequency?
projectSnapshot.notes:
Expected: At 1 kHz, increasing capacitance lowers output magnitude and moves phase toward −90°. Each trial captures a fresh complete response and the interpolated complex value at the selected frequency.
Try: Open Analog experiments, sweep C1.value logarithmically from 10n to 1u with 9 trials, select Output and AC magnitude at 1k. Repeat with AC phase or a tolerance study.
assumptions: Lumped circuit elements and ideal independent sources.
Model outputs are numerical predictions; validate a physical design using component data and measurements.
